Name: SH's More JojaMart Staff
Author: plurffle
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/0jybXZM.png[/img]
This small mod adds the extra JojaMart minor NPCs that you see in one cutscene after the Community Center is converted into a Joja Warehouse. [b]ONE SINGLE [/b]cutscene and never seen again after/prior. I had the idea of seeing them a bit more and here we are.

Since this is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] mod, these are minor NPCs (anti-social NPCs in a way) who mainly roam inside the JojaMart and can be briefly interacted with everyday unless the JojaMart business is terminated. They will mainly give you generic dialogue related to their job at Joja (so expect rather repetitive dialogue at times because they're on the clock!). You will see one of the five workers in the building (scheduled per day, but can be toggled to randomize which one you'll come across) with a very small chance of appearing at the saloon after work (can be toggled off). You may also come across a certain lost Joja NPC!

Now, I don't think it makes sense for Pelican Town's JojaMart to even have that many workers, so by default the mod only adds them into the game [b]after[/b] the Joja Warehouse has been completed. This can be toggled off though, so you can have them showing up without buying the membership (but they will be gone forever once the Community Center is complete!).

I've had this mod sitting in my files since 2021 according to my PC! It was [i]technically[/i] finished since then, I don't know why I never uploaded it. Perhaps I simply didn't like it enough to share yet. I decided to tweak it more to my liking and upload this just because I apparently love to fill the SDV world with life and movement!


[img]https://imgur.com/Yks3p40.png[/img]
[b]Q: How to install this mod?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Unzip the zip file and place the "SH's More JojaMart Staff" folder in your Mods folder.

[b]Q: Why am I not seeing any of the new NPCs when I visit JojaMart?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The default setting only allows them to show up in your playthrough [i]after[/i] the Joja Warehouse is completed. Turning off the "More Joja staff only when Warehouse completed" config setting lets you see them [i]without[/i] having to buy a Joja Membership. Once you finish the Community Center however, they will leave the town completely.

[b]Q: Why are they not showing up in our relationships tab?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]These are minor NPCs/anti-social NPCs in the same way Marlon and Gus are. You can talk to them a bit and watch them move around in JojaMart, but they're not giftable and cannot gain relationship points.
